note: Fits the shape of the ICP everywhere except occupation. He is an onsite manager of a storage facility who also handles a couple of Airbnbs in Sedona — not a business owner, physician or equivalent, and he lives on the site he manages. On the other four criteria he is a clean match: health is plainly the neglected area rather than a crisis ('I'm sick and tired of letting myself go'), he is already training kettlebells five days a week and mountain biking, he has taken himself from 227 lb to 210 lb unaided, and he is asking for progression rather than rescue. Income is scored as a match with a caveat — he accepted $6,000 without a flicker of resistance and holds precious metals, but he has no liquid cash and has to sell physical gold to fund it, which the stated criterion 'makes good money' does not distinguish from wealth on paper.
